## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit prefixes (`feat|fix|refactor|chore|docs|ci`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated; `python3 -m pytest tests -q` passes
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames or personal/company names
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Security impact considered (auth, command execution, tokens)
